## Change / 变更

Describe the user-facing problem and resulting behavior. / 说明问题及变更后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

List relevant checks and their results. Cleanup/persistence changes need preservation and failure-path coverage. / 列出相关检查及结果；清理与持久化变更需要数据保留和失败路径测试。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Mention any changed formats, supported versions, or recovery behavior. Keep real sessions, backups, credentials, and private paths out of this PR. / 说明格式、支持版本或恢复行为的变化；不要提交真实会话、备份、凭据及私人路径。
